# heurema

> Shared HNSW vector, BM25 full-text, persistence, and reciprocal-rank-fusion search primitives for the forkwright fleet. One implementation, one proof, orthogonal to query engines.

## Architecture

Structured LLM corpus:

- [_llm/architecture.toml](_llm/architecture.toml): crate roles and layer relationships
- [_llm/current_state.toml](_llm/current_state.toml): current phase and active threads
- [_llm/decisions.toml](_llm/decisions.toml): accepted decisions

## Agent entry points

- [README.md](README.md): purpose, status, API surface
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): repo conventions for AI coding agents
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): onboarding + dispatch conventions
- [crates/heurema/src/lib.rs](crates/heurema/src/lib.rs): public API root
- [kanon/projects/heurema/](https://github.com/forkwright/kanon/tree/main/projects/heurema): canonical planning (STATE / ROADMAP / vision / design)
